title: Goldfish eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD966'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FF9F1C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E86A00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='finGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFB347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D9600F'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M68 45 Q82 34 86 22 Q76 36 78 46 Q86 56 88 70 Q78 60 68 56 Z' fill='#FFB347' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M70 48 Q80 40 82 30' stroke='#D9600F' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M70 52 Q80 60 82 68' stroke='#D9600F' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- top fin -->
  <path d='M42 30 Q50 14 62 22 Q54 28 52 36 Z' fill='#FFB347' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M48 26 Q54 20 58 24' stroke='#D9600F' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- bottom fin -->
  <path d='M44 62 Q48 74 58 72 Q52 66 52 60 Z' fill='#FFB347' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='46' rx='28' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)' stroke='#FFE08A' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#FFE08A' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- scales hint -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q44 56 50 52' stroke='#E86A00' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M44 56 Q50 60 56 56' stroke='#E86A00' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M32 48 Q38 52 44 48' stroke='#E86A00' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='6' fill='#FFE08A' stroke='#E86A00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2E0A66'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M18 46 Q15 50 18 54' stroke='#E86A00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- snack (cracker) -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='49' r='5' fill='#C87B3A' stroke='#E8A765' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='14.5' cy='47.5' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='47.5' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='14.5' cy='51' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='51' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='16.5' cy='49.5' r='0.8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#8EE8FF' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='none' stroke='#8EE8FF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='28' r='1.3' fill='none' stroke='#8EE8FF' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
